text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...That's a tricky problem. A shift at 
the front affects everyone behind them, 
too."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Do you think so as well? ...However, 
things take on myriad forms. I'd like to 
alter its shape and discover new value 
within it.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I see... Honoring the predecessors, while 
also incorporating changes that reflect 
the subtle nuances today's youth would 
feel.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. But this too must have been born 
from countless twists and turns. I never 
thought it'd be easy.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Let us think. As long as we keep our 
minds working, something will surely come 
of it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Impressive as always, Ikuno Dictus. I'm 
glad I counted on you.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I'll hear those words after we have our 
answer. —First, let's brainstorm 
candidates from the same category.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: In that case—it's gotta be the "futon."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, and that leads right into "it got 
blown away."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Every single one of these would cause a 
disaster if blown away. It really won't be 
easy after all...
